content: If no Event is assigned per DTR , the Dem shall reset the DTR data upon a Service$04 clear command by the Dcm , i.e. a Dem_ClearDTC with: DTC = DEM_DTC_GROUP_ALL_DTCS DTCFormat = DEM_DTC_FORMAT_OBD DTCOrigin = DEM_DTC_ORIGIN_PRIMARY_MEMORY
